title: Ongoing Registry of Treatment of Venous Thromboembolism
brief_summary: Ongoing registration of patients with venous thromboembolism treated by means of antithrombotic therapy, thrombolisys, open surgery, endovenous desobstruction and stenting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* case of venous thrombosis of a limb or pulmonary embolus

Exclusion Criteria:

* no exclusion criteria
study_population: Patients undergoing any kind of treatment for venous thromboembolism
